notes.zh: 新增应用内更新提醒与设置中的检查更新入口。
notes.en: Adds in-app update reminders and a manual update check in Settings.

notes.zh: 设置抽屉标题固定显示，完善分组和分隔线；情绪记录固定双方可见；优化邀请流程，安装包缩小约 79%。
notes.en: Pinned Settings header and clearer groups; moods are always shared with your partner. Improved invitations and an APK about 79% smaller.
